scope: The 1899 municipal building in Douglas, Isle of Man, as photographed in 2013. Includes its rounded roof turret, stepped gable, projecting clock, dark local rubble and Bath stone trim.

originalReview.notes: Street-side photograph shows the stepped gable and oculus, pale rectangular mullions, block cornices and projecting clock. The roof turret has pale frames and a rounded grey metal roof with finial.
The 1899 municipal buildings plaque and its two-tone ashlar surround establish the limestone tone, broken dark stone courses and pale carved frame.

quallaSearch.notes: The two inspected Qualla exterior photos are exact byte matches to Man vyi’s Wikimedia originals. In the native permission record the uploading photographer identifies them as own photos and releases them into the public domain.
